sn17.24:1.3: saddhā bhikkhave, upāsikā ekaṃ dhītikaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ evaṃ sammā āyācamānā āyāceyya:
sn17.24:1.4: “tādisā ayye, bhavāhi, yādisā khujjuttarā upāsikā veḷukaṇṭakiyā ca nandamātā”ti.
sn17.24:1.5: esā bhikkhave tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ yadidaṃ khujjuttarā ca upāsikā, veḷukaṇṭakiyā ca nandamātā.
sn17.24:1.6: “sace kho tvaṃ ayye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajasi,
sn17.24:1.7: tādisā ayye bhavāhi, yādisā khemā ca bhikkhunī, uppalavaṇṇācā”ti.
sn17.24:1.8: esā bhikkhave, tulā, etaṃ pamāṇaṃ, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ yadidaṃ khemā ca bhikkhunī uppalavaṇṇā ca.
sn17.24:1.9: “mā ca kho tvaṃ ayye sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇātū”ti.
sn17.24:1.10: tañce bhikkhave, bhikkhuniṃ sekhaṃ appattamānasaṃ lābhasakkārasiloko anupāpuṇāti, so tassā hoti antarāyāya.
sn17.24:1.12: [uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma …pe…] evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave, sikkhitabbanti.
